name: MangoLeafBD: A Comprehensive Image Dataset to Classify Diseased and Healthy Mango Leaves
description: MangoLeafBD is a comprehensive visual benchmark dataset comprising 4,000 mango leaf images designed for automated classification of diseased and healthy mango leaves. Originating from mango orchards in Bangladesh, the dataset captures around 1,800 distinct physical leaves photographed under natural illumination across eight distinct categories: Anthracnose, Bacterial Canker, Cutting Weevil, Die Back, Gall Midge, Powdery Mildew, Sooty Mould, and Healthy. Images are standardized at 240x320 pixels in JPEG format. Prepared to advance computer vision and agricultural diagnostics in tropical fruit cultivation, MangoLeafBD supports supervised deep learning classification, transfer learning, and mobile-edge plant health assessment.
